title: Understanding-First AI Engineering: Purposes, Reference Architecture, and Architectural Patterns for Human Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.13022v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI systems can produce reliable results without developing human understanding. However, human understanding remains valuable for shaping subsequent AI-supported work, forming preferences, governing collective choices and satisfying curiosity, even when human participation is unnecessary for correcting errors. We propose understanding-first AI engineering, which treats purpose-specific human understanding as a first-class design principle guiding requirements, design and operation. The purposes of understanding are organised into four complementary rationales: reflective agency, effective action, collective governance and epistemic value. A reference architecture connects production, verification, use, and learning and exploration through shared records, supporting understanding through explanation and participation. translated_title: 理解优先的AI工程：面向人类理解的目的、参考架构与架构模式
translated_abstract: AI系统可以在不发展人类理解的情况下产生可靠的结果。然而，即使人类的参与对于纠正错误并非必要，人类理解对于塑造后续AI支持的工作、形成偏好、治理集体选择以及满足好奇心，仍然具有重要价值。我们提出“理解优先的AI工程”，将特定目的的人类理解作为指导需求、设计和运营的一等设计原则。理解的目的被组织为四种互补的理据：反思性主体性、有效行动、集体治理和认知价值。一个参考架构通过共享记录连接生产、验证、使用以及学习与探索等环节，并通过解释和参与来支持理解。五种候选架构模式指导关于并行学习、解释性模型、目标探索、受众适配等方面的选择。
tldr: 该论文提出“理解优先的AI工程”新范式，将特定目的的人类理解作为一等设计原则，归纳了反思性主体、有效行动、集体治理和认知价值四种理解目的，并给出贯穿生产、验证、使用与学习的参考架构及五种候选架构模式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "understanding-first AI engineering," which treats purpose-specific human understanding as a first-class design principle, organizing its purposes into four complementary rationales and providing a reference architecture and five candidate architectural patterns.
